title: AIDP A2App standard client target
description: Non-secret configuration. Credentials remain in OCI configuration and are consumed by OCI CLI.

endpoint.description: Advertised HTTPS A2A endpoint, ending in /a2a; never a chat endpoint or guessed control-plane route.

runtimeRevision.description: Exact revision returned by this agent's A2App responses.

definitionFile.description: Saved complete component definition JSON; relative paths resolve from this configuration file.

stateDirectory.description: Dedicated private client receipt directory for this binding/revision. Contains no authoritative business state.

expectedHostname.description: Optional exact, user-approved endpoint hostname for a sovereign/other OCI realm. No wildcards.

agentCardUrl.description: Optional advertised Agent Card URL under endpoint; no discovery path is guessed.
